ordinal_path_rel.note: ordinal_path_rel i j: the indices are consecutive in either order, ((val i).+1 == val j) || ((val j).+1 == val i); no guard (irreflexive by itself: ordinal_path_rel_irrefl) and no modular wrap (ordinal_path_ends).

ordinal_path.note: ordinal_path n: upstream SGraph on 'I_n from ordinal_path_rel with its symmetry and irreflexivity proofs; n vertices (card_ordinal_path), the empty graph for n = 0, no edge for n = 1, one edge for n = 2; a tree of maximum degree at most two (ordinal_path_path_tree).

ordinal_path_lt_set.note: ordinal_path_lt_set A B: every vertex of A has a smaller index than every vertex of B; an auxiliary order on vertex sets used only to prove that P_n has no K_3 minor (ordinal_path_K3_free), not a migrated contract.
